findings.evidence: Lines 298–300 list `hA`, `hAT`, `hAfinite`, and `hATfinite`; `Special.lean` lines 141–148 and 299–306 separately supply all four. Mathlib has `Matrix.mulVec_injective_of_det_ne_zero`, and transposition preserves the determinant.
findings.fix: State `ofMatrix` with a single `A.det ≠ 0` hypothesis (or one equivalent full-rank hypothesis) and derive injectivity and finite index for `A` and `Aᵀ` internally.
findings.issue: `ofMatrix` requires four separate injectivity/finite-index proofs, although for a square integer matrix all four follow from `A.det ≠ 0`; both special isogenies consequently duplicate square arguments for `A` and `Aᵀ`.

findings.evidence: Lines 271 and 280 hard-code `(Fin n → ℤ) →ₗ[ℤ] (Fin n → ℤ)`; the injectivity proof only uses torsion-freeness, while the finite-index argument only needs finite freeness to make multiplication by nonzero `c` finite-index.
findings.fix: Generalize the injectivity lemma to an arbitrary torsion-free ℤ-module and the finite-index lemma to an arbitrary finite free ℤ-module, then specialize them in `Special.lean`.
findings.issue: The two public `linearMap_*_of_comp_self_eq_nsmul` lemmas are restricted to `Fin n → ℤ` despite their docstrings and proofs expressing general facts about torsion-free, respectively finite free, abelian groups.

summary: The coordinate constructor and its supporting lemmas expose unnecessarily specialized or redundant hypotheses.
